description_excerpt: At Siemens Mobility , we enable our customers worldwide to realise sustainable mobility solutions. As a leading technology company, we combine the real and digital worlds like no other in rail. The Project Director will lead the delivery of the Rail Systems scope for the Viet Nam High Speed Rail project . Based in Hanoi, this senior leadership role has overall responsibility for project performance, including delivery, budget, quality, customer satisfaction, stakeholder management, and the leadership of a large international project organisation.
